_definitions.scope: PAPER_18=18-session benchmark; retained23/pool30/all_paired=cohort multiverse; sessions with zero valid windows are excluded from all per-measurement aggregates.
_definitions.per_session_rmse: RMSE_k = sqrt(mean((est-ref)^2)) over the session's valid 30-s windows; sessions weighted equally (per-measurement mean = unweighted mean of RMSE_k).
_definitions.dft_nls_nmf_hpss: Per-measurement means of per-session RMSE for each branch.
_definitions.const_global_oracle: Per-measurement mean of per-session RMSE of (ref vs the cohort-pooled mean of all valid refs) -- in-sample constant predictor.
_definitions.const_loso: Per-measurement mean of per-session RMSE of (ref vs the MEDIAN of the OTHER sessions' pooled valid refs) -- leave-one-session-out constant predictor.
_definitions.session_mean_oracle: Mean across sessions of the per-session reference SD -- lower bound for within-session tracking RMSE.
_definitions.paired: delta_k = RMSE_hpss_k - RMSE_nmf_k; stats over sessions. loo_range = min/max of the mean delta when each single session is left out. largest_abs_deltas = top-3 |delta_k| with session id.
_definitions.tost_0p5: Paired one-sample TOST at margin +-0.50 bpm: p = max(P(t>t1), P(t<t2)); ci90 = mean +- t_{0.95,n-1}*SE (sample SD). patient_level = per-patient mean of session deltas. max_abs_patient_ci90_bound = largest |CI bound|; patient-level equivalence holds iff this is < 0.50 (it is 0.508 for all_paired -> patient-level TOST p=0.0528, i.e. marginal failure at the widest cohort; the pre-registered analysis unit is the session).
_definitions.window_level_PAPER18: Pooled over PAPER_18 valid windows. harmonic bins: est/ref ratio in [0.4,0.6] (half) or [1.8,2.2] (double); gross = |err|>10 bpm. Bland-Altman: bias +- 1.96*sample_sd(ddof=1) of (est-ref). heavy_move = windows with n_removed>2 (minmove False).
_definitions.mitigation_vs_raw: Per-measurement paired comparison of each mitigated branch vs Raw NLS; wins = sessions with lower RMSE; two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank.
_definitions.lags: Synchronization lag (s) stored in the provenance-locked caches (evaluation.sync_arrays, metadata-anchored +-60 s search).
